card.name: Linking words before triamterene or hydrochlorothiazide
card.fires_on: Small linking words and commas (of, including, and, comma) right before a diuretic name like triamterene, amiloride or hydrochlorothiazide. Seen in potassium-sparing diuretic and thiazide labels.

modes.label: Of before thiazide
modes.description: The word 'of' after a dose or noun, just before hydrochlorothiazide or triamterene.
modes.example: Patients usually do not require doses in excess of 50 mg<< of>> hydrochlorothiazide daily when used

modes.label: Comma in diuretic lists
modes.description: A comma or 'e.g.,' inside a list of potassium-sparing diuretics, before the next drug name.

card.plain: It fires on the small word or comma just before the next diuretic name in potassium-sparing diuretic text.
